scope: Read-only evidence from the user-provided Super-version ROM and a public scan of the Namco FC manual; not a claim that every fan version has identical numeric tables.

original_table.lookup_consumer: 25:A0AA calls A19F city count, A0AD reads index $0003, A0B0 loads A0E4,Y, A0B3 stores RAM $6F05

facts_tc: 命令書為君主／勢力共用額度，額度內可對同一城反覆下令。
數量依領城數增減；用完輪到下一君主，全部君主行動一巡為一個月。
任命太守不消耗命令書。
原版僅分配現有預備兵，要從徵兵選擇僱用0人，再進入配兵流程；不是另外的免費編兵命令。
原版町有武器屋、學問所、病院、商店；醫療每次50金。

entries.proves: Every selected ruler turn counts cities and replaces RAM6F05 from the indexed table; it does not add a carry-over balance.
Counts the thirty original city owner records for the selected ruler.
Command-bar selection enters a child menu; entering the top-level city/army/warehouse/town category itself does not decrement6F05.
Shared concrete-command confirmation; cancellation has no decrement, acceptance sets046C=80 and subtracts one book when046C reaches40.
The single direct DEC $6F05 instruction in the pinned ROM.
Domestic development confirmation uses D5BD, reads chosen officer intellect and modifies city development/resources; the inspected path does not mark a once-per-ruler-turn officer lock.
Recruitment confirmation charges one through D5BD before recruitment and troop allocation. The subsequent allocation step does not add a second book charge.
The town entry dispatches its phases without a separate book debit.
Concrete rice trades, treasure sales, healing/study confirmation and equipment purchase each call D5BD; equipment purchase then writes officer equipment and pays city gold.

Unmodified native-core cold-start replay: three confirmed recruit/allocation operations at the same Cao Cao city spend3→2→1→0; first request is capped to0 but accepted and assigns reserves; subsequent allocations give Yu Jin100 twice. Six AI turns then advance January toFebruary and refill3. This is not a dedicated repeated-domestic-executor replay.

confirmed_rules.original_refresh_period: one ruler turn per calendar month
confirmed_rules.same_officer_repeat_evidence: Inspected domestic-development source does not write a strategic once-per-turn action lock; no new native emulator replay is claimed.

remake_adaptations.description_tc: 保留本作已確定的每旬10日回合；在旬界重新發放，並非把原版月制誤稱為旬制。
115城地圖超過原版30城時沿用原表上限13；不讀取原表以外的程式資料，也不虛構原版115城公式。
本作把全城配兵獨立成彈窗；首次有效兵數變更扣1本並保存當旬／勢力／城池及已付收據綁定的流程，同流程可連續分配多名武將，不逐將扣書。徵募後接入同一已付流程不再扣書；關閉或其他戰略命令結束流程，重開另計。原版對應為僱用0人的徵兵及整次分配共1本。
本作查看、預覽、政策設定與檔案／雲端存取維持免費操作；不能據此宣稱它們與原版所有同名選單逐項相同。
現有擴充自動內政及運輸使用相同勢力額度；若配兵只是已支付徵兵命令中的一個步驟，不重複扣書。
